laws.rule: Galicia's tourist stay tax (imposto galego sobre as estadías turísticas, Lei 5/2024, in force from 1 January 2025) sets rates of EUR 1 to EUR 2.50 per person per night (about A$1.59 to A$3.97), counted for up to 5 nights per stay, but gives a 100% rebate, so the regional tax itself costs nothing. A council can add its own surcharge of up to 100% of the listed rate by local ordinance, and where it does, visitors pay that surcharge through their accommodation. Cruise calls are covered too. Exempt: minors, people with a disability of 65% or more, stays in the Xunta's public pilgrim hostels (Plan Xacobeo) and youth hostels; stays for care in the Galician public health system are not taxed. AUD at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = EUR 0.6293.
